name: Yila
description: Search, read and verify papers, format references, and draw editable scientific figures with Yila.
description_zh: 查中英文文献、读全文、核验引用、排参考文献（含 GB/T 7714），画能逐元素编辑的科研图。
description_en: Search, read and verify papers, format references, and draw editable scientific figures with Yila.
examples_zh: 用 Yila 深度检索近五年肠道菌群与抑郁症的研究，包含中文文献
用 Yila 读这几篇论文的全文，比较样本量和主要结论，标出页码
核验这段综述里的每条引用，再按 GB/T 7714 排好参考文献
根据附件论文，用 Yila 画一张 16:9 的图形摘要
examples_en: Use Yila to run a deep search on gut microbiota and depression from the last five years, including Chinese papers
Read the full text of these papers with Yila and compare sample sizes and main findings, with page numbers
Check every reference in this review and format them in GB/T 7714
Draw a 16:9 graphical abstract of the attached paper with Yila
